FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 147
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 147 as introduced could increase receipts, by undetermined amounts, to the Public
Safety Fund and the Public Road and Bridge Fund from civil traffic citations issued by the
Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) in the amount of $200, to persons recorded
speeding by an automated photographic speed enforcement system in a construction zone; and
could decrease receipts, by a corresponding amount to the State General Fund.
Additionally, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and the county general
funds to which court costs are deposited dependent on the number of people determined to be
liable for a construction zone speeding violation after an adjudicative hearing or that failed to
appear for an adjudicative hearing for the speeding violation.
Finally, this bill could increase the obligations to the Alabama Department of Transportation
(DOT) for the installation of automated speed enforcement systems in construction zones on
public highways, depending on the number of automated speed enforcement systems installed.
Per the department the cost for automated speed enforcement system placed in a work zone can
range from $200,000-$400,000, depending on the length of the construction project.
